palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed 23px Idle colors, including source blue eyes, dark pupils, orange face and body, pale belly, blue stripes and white claws. No invented eye or mouth pixels.
reference: Own DSTS chr564 mesh, eye meshes, skeleton and native clips. Action names and events use the PMDO registry.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native claw spread and strike. ba01 was rejected because its root motion crossed the 64px cell edges.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native chest and arm expression; no projectile asset.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native seated resting pose; source eye expression retained.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native recoil, including lifted head and limbs.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own bg01 arm sweep. bs01 leaves the camera after its opening frames and was rejected.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two repeats of the native claw strike; PMDO exposes one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native forward leap with fixed shadow and preserved vertical movement.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native anticipation and release, without aura or effects.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native gaze clip plus explicit whole-view turn, excluding the endpoint.
